title: Iran War Talks Stall: What It Means for Oil and the Strait of Hormuz
description: An animated explainer breaking down why US-Iran peace talks over the Strait of Hormuz have stalled, how Iran's blockade is disrupting global shipping, and what a potential deal means for energy markets.
